Last updated: April 2026

At Shamanicca (shamanicca.com), your privacy matters to us. This Privacy Policy explains what information we collect, how we use it, and what rights you have regarding your personal data. If you have any questions, reach us at contact@shamanicca.com.

This policy applies to information collected through our website only. It does not apply to information collected offline or through any other channels.

1. Consent

By using our website, you consent to this Privacy Policy and agree to its terms.

2. Information We Collect

We collect information in the following ways:

  • When you place an order — name, shipping address, email address, and payment information (processed securely by Stripe — we never store your card details).
  • When you create an account — name, email address, and password.
  • When you contact us — name, email, and the content of your message.
  • When you subscribe to our newsletter — email address and subscription preferences.
  • Automatically via log files — IP address, browser type, referring pages, date/time stamp, and page interactions. This data is not linked to any personally identifiable information.

3. How We Use Your Information

  • Process and fulfill your orders
  • Communicate with you about your order, account, or support request
  • Send you newsletters and product updates (only if you opted in — unsubscribe any time)
  • Improve and personalize your experience on our website
  • Analyze site usage and performance
  • Detect and prevent fraud
  • Comply with legal obligations

4. Cookies

We use cookies to store visitor preferences, improve site functionality, and understand how visitors navigate the site. You can disable cookies through your browser settings, though some features of the site may not function correctly without them.

We use a cookie consent banner to give you control over non-essential cookies before they are set.

5. Third-Party Services

We work with trusted third-party partners to operate our store. Each has its own privacy practices:

  • Stripe — payment processing. stripe.com/privacy
  • Printful — order production and fulfillment. printful.com/policies/privacy
  • Mailchimp — newsletter and email marketing. mailchimp.com/legal/privacy
  • Google Analytics — website analytics. policies.google.com/privacy

We do not sell your personal information to any third party. Ever.

6. Your Rights

Canadian residents (PIPEDA)
Right to access your personal data, right to correct inaccurate information, and right to withdraw consent for non-essential uses. We will respond to requests within 30 days.

European residents (GDPR)
Right to access, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing, data portability, and the right to object. We will respond to requests within 30 days.

California residents (CCPA)
Right to know what personal data we collect, right to request deletion, and right to opt out of the sale of personal data. We do not sell personal data. We will respond to requests within 30 days.

To exercise any of these rights, email us at contact@shamanicca.com.

7. Children’s Privacy

Shamanicca does not knowingly collect personal information from children under the age of 13. If you believe your child has submitted personal information on our website, please contact us at contact@shamanicca.com and we will remove it promptly.

8. Data Retention

We retain your personal data only for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes described in this policy, or as required by law. Order data is retained for a minimum of 7 years for tax and accounting purposes. You may request deletion of your account and associated data at any time, subject to legal retention requirements.

9. Changes to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. When we do, we will update the “Last updated” date at the top of this page. Continued use of the website after any changes constitutes your acceptance of the updated policy.

10. Contact Us

If you have questions or concerns about this Privacy Policy or how your data is handled, please reach out:

Shamanicca
Email: contact@shamanicca.com
Website: shamanicca.com
